kind: Independent SWZ14 original-source contract and physical/source predicate interpretation
status: Bounded interpretation only; not a qualification, disposition, or final-head review.

original_contract.question: Qualify the unique current-location source membership, retained territorial exclusions and complete source competitors; then derive and verify a zero-reassignment additive native patch.
original_contract.completion: Every exact interval is either a qualified additive repair to its recorded location or a documented exception; run actual selected-native conservation and source/physical witness checks. Existing river water remains location-owned.
original_contract.interpretation: Positive repair is possible when source membership at the recorded location, territorial exclusions and complete source competitors are supported; the resulting additive native patch must be zero-reassignment and pass actual selected-native conservation plus source/physical witness checks. Every interval can alternatively complete as a documented exception. Neither exception language nor this assessment makes a source gap an automatic qualification.

reviewed_stock_predicates.finding: The retained original source-contact result is pinned to this stock source. The independent reconstruction records exact-center point membership against complete retained provider-family features; 14/14 keys have one unique ADM2 match in the simplified family, with zero boundary ties. It is a source-contact result, not by itself present territorial adjudication or source-authority validation.

Source-target preparation compares each consumed target geometry to the authenticated original feature, uses complete supplied negative-family feature sets, and retains candidate/competitor witnesses. The code labels negative scope as conservative disagreement rather than legal sovereignty/applicability adjudication and keeps native source/owner/physical/geometry qualification required. Source evidence can optionally carry territorial applicability; no general current-boundary certificate is encoded as a universal gate.

The measured physical producer authenticates the staged whole-target source geometry and physical inputs. Its receipt reports physical support only; it does not decide territorial scope, current applicability, source ancestry, or native conservation.

retained_source_and_parent_context.parent_interpretation: The 4 ADM1 polygons provide one broad-region spatial contact for each original key. Their roster direct-owner arrays are empty. The matching owner lineage province IDs align with those region names, but the GeoJSON properties have no parent field; these contacts establish spatial/tier context, not standalone parent ancestry, ownership, territorial exclusion, or competitor completeness.

physical_result.scope: eight staged source targets, each exactly equal to the retained simplified ADM2 feature; zero exactly equal to full ADM2 geometry

retained_source_and_parent_context.meaning: All 14 keys are land and have unique direct simplified-ADM2 source contacts. Each also has one broad ADM1 spatial contact whose source-roster direct-owner list is empty; the owner province lineage agrees with the region name, but source geometries contain no explicit parent pointer. These contacts help describe tier/region context, not direct ADM2 ancestry or competitor clearance. The scoped candidate/competitor family for the original route is the complete 53-feature 2017 simplified ADM2 product consumed by the queue and physical stage; all 53 full-geometry features remain examined as representation context and are not required to replace the simplified candidate.

key_level_representation_adverse_facts.all14_simplified: Every original key has exactly one simplified ADM2 contact matching its recorded ADM2 source ID; zero ties.
key_level_representation_adverse_facts.8_full_geometry: Eight of the 14 keys also hit the exact same ADM2 feature in the full geometry. These are consistent across the two retained representations, subject to complete competitor and territorial/source applicability predicates.
key_level_representation_adverse_facts.interpretation: The six are point-membership representation differences, not six proven wrong assignments and not six automatically qualified repairs. A positive path for any must state which authenticated 2017 product is the intended source geometry and show the actual stock source/negative evidence and selected-native conservation for that exact key. The complete source geometry family can help determine uniqueness, but feature-count or same-name evidence alone does not resolve which representation governs.
key_level_representation_adverse_facts.no_threshold: The original contract has no 8-of-14 or 8/6 decision threshold. The representation split must be assessed per key using the source product actually nominated and its complete same-tier competitors.

tikhuba_distinct_role_question.geometry_fact: Tikhuba is one of the six simplified-only points; simplified feature matches, full ADM2 feature does not cover the point.
tikhuba_distinct_role_question.role_fact: Retained official EBC indexed tables associate Tikhuba with Matsanjeni North as a chiefdom in 2013/2018 and again in 2023. The 2013 evidence predates the source represented year 2017. The full EBC responses were not retained and the copyright-marked map was not downloaded.
tikhuba_distinct_role_question.difference_from_other13: This is an additional source-role/tier ambiguity beyond the representation issue. No corresponding conflicting named role was identified for the other 13 keys in the retained research. It does not prove a rename, parent relation, exact geometry, or alternative ownership; the Lubombo contact and lineage are broad parent-region context only.
tikhuba_distinct_role_question.key_specific_followup: The eventual stock evidence must keep the Inkhundla Tikhuba source identity and the EBC chiefdom/Matsanjeni North association explicit, without silently substituting one for the other. If no lawful exact geometry/role evidence resolves the role, preserve that key-specific uncertainty.

independent_decision_guidance.can_positive_source_path_exist: Yes, in principle: the contract does not impose a blanket latest-boundary certificate, and authenticated source membership, all same-tier competitors, explicit broader-role context, physical evidence and selected-native proof could support a positive repair for individual keys.
independent_decision_guidance.not_yet_supported: The retained evidence alone does not satisfy source applicability/territorial exclusions, complete scoped competitors, and selected-native conservation for a blanket 14-key positive conclusion. The simplified/full representation differences must be addressed per key but do not automatically disqualify the simplified source. Tikhuba adds a distinct role conflict.
independent_decision_guidance.what_actual_upcoming_diagnostic_must_sho: For each exact key: use the complete 53-feature ORIGINAL SIMPLIFIED ADM2 family as the actual scoped candidate/competitor basis (it is the product consumed by the original queue and bound to the physical stage); report the full same-release ADM2 geometry comparison as adverse representation evidence, not as a mandatory replacement; keep the four ADM1 contacts as parent context rather than direct owners; retain any territorial/foreign negatives with bounded scope; bind physical support to the exact simplified inputs; and supply additive patch/current selected-native conservation. The provider’s complete 53-feature family proves that provider release’s roster coverage only, not completeness of a current legal roster.
independent_decision_guidance.not_required_by_this_contract_read: An invented universal certificate of present official boundaries or full modern crosswalk is not a default prerequisite. The 2017 source metadata and retained original geometry may be usable if the per-key evidence and source role are adequately supported; where evidence conflicts, use the documented-exception route without claiming qualification.
independent_decision_guidance.no_preapproval: This is a predicate interpretation for independent review planning, not approval of any future diagnostic, source choice, native patch, exception, or public packet.
